score_metadata.beat_unit: quarter note; source beat zero at source time zero
warnings: Notated order only; repeat signs are not expanded.
Seconds follow encoded tempo, not a recording. Grace notes are omitted.
Hairpins and articulations are not converted to performed timing or velocity.

timing.source_origin: source start = 0 seconds = 0 beats; not measure number
timing.excerpt_origin: selected window start = 0 excerpt seconds = 0 excerpt beats
timing.tempo_policy: piecewise constant quarter BPM; integrate across changes
timing.note_id_scope: id is excerpt-local; source_note_id is source-stable before crop

source_identity.scope: same source bytes, parser name/version and sn1 policy; independent of path, crop, fallback BPM and canonical part mapping
source_identity.part_order: source MusicXML part order or pretty_midi nonempty instrument order; not raw MIDI track index
source_identity.event_order: full source events sorted stably by onset then concert MIDI pitch; zero-based per source part
source_identity.tie_policy: one ID per tie-merged pitched event, not per MusicXML segment
source_identity.chord_policy: one ID per chord pitch; duplicate unisons retain distinct ordinals
source_identity.grace_policy: MusicXML zero-duration grace notes omitted; no performed onset inferred
source_identity.revision_policy: source edits, parser upgrades or policy changes require new identities; no cross-revision matching

alignment_method: symbolic chroma vs CQT; subsequence endpoint search then fixed-origin DTW
alignment_endpoint_assumption: existing candidate may contain fractional-feature-frame endpoint extrapolation; not refitted
alignment_selection: raw DTW A; provisional, not manually accuracy-validated
